name: snowfall-bg
title: Snowfall Background
blurb: Snow particles drift down at varying speeds and opacity.
description: Canvas-based particle animation with randomized drift and fall; uses requestAnimationFrame and setTimeout for staggered spawn.
use_when: Seasonal or winter-themed hero backgrounds for festive sections.
avoid_when: High-performance requirements; rapidly scrolling pages with many particle components.
a11y: Decorative canvas background. No motion guard.
